question: What was the loss ratio for each product in 2025?

sql: select count(*) n, count(distinct payment_id) dp, (select count(*) from (select claim_id,payment_date,amount,payee_type from claim_payments group by all having count(*)>1)) dupgroups, (select count(*) from claim_payments where load_batch not like 'nightly-%') nonnightly, (select count(*) from claim_payments where amount<=0) nonpos, (select count(*) from claim_payments p left join claims c using(claim_id) where c.claim_id is null) orphans, (select count(*) from (select claim_id from claims group by 1 having count(*)>1)) dupclaims from claim_payments

select load_batch, count(*) n, sum(amount) from claim_payments where load_batch not like 'nightly-%' or load_batch in (select load_batch from claim_payments group by 1 having count(*)>1000) group by 1 order by n desc limit 20

with pay as (select claim_id, sum(amount) paid from claim_payments where load_batch not like 'reload-%' group by 1),
inc as (select c.product, sum(coalesce(p.paid,0)+c.reserve_amount) incurred from claims c left join pay p using(claim_id) where c.loss_date between '2025-01-01' and '2025-12-31' group by 1),
ep as (select product, sum(earned_premium) ep from exposure_monthly where month between '2025-01-01' and '2025-12-01' group by 1)
select product, round(incurred,2) incurred, round(ep,2) earned_premium, round(incurred/ep,4) loss_ratio from inc join ep using(product) order by product
select round(sum(amount),2) from claim_payments p join claims c using(claim_id) where load_batch like 'reload-%' and c.loss_date between '2025-01-01' and '2025-12-31'

report.interpretation: Loss ratio = incurred (paid + current reserve) divided by earned premium. I counted claims by loss date in calendar 2025 and used earned premium from exposure_monthly for Jan–Dec 2025, by product. I excluded 159 duplicate payment rows from the 'reload-2026-03-14' batch.
report.answer: 2025 loss ratios were 53.6% for auto and 54.3% for home. Auto had about $15.96M incurred on $29.77M earned premium. Home had about $13.02M incurred on $23.99M earned premium. Late-reported and slow-settling claims (bodily injury and liability) may still develop, so these ratios could rise.

data_quality_issues.issue: 159 payment rows (about $893K in total) were loaded a second time in batch 'reload-2026-03-14'. They duplicate existing nightly payments.
data_quality_issues.impact: Including them would overstate 2025 incurred by about $159K. I excluded them.

data_quality_issues.issue: Claims from 2025 may not be fully developed. Bodily injury and liability claims are reported late and settle slowly, and reserves are estimates.
data_quality_issues.impact: 2025 loss ratios may change as claims develop.

proposed_actions.title: Remove duplicate payments from reload-2026-03-14 batch
proposed_actions.reason: 159 payment rows duplicate payments already loaded in nightly batches, which inflates paid amounts.
